I visited Andrea at her Ossington location to sit down and chat all about how she started experimenting with baking cookies at home during the pandemic and then turned it into a cookie brand that Toronto loves, all within just a few years. 

She’s built a cult following, has endless creativity when it comes to new flavours on the menu, and she’s opened four gorgeous retail shops that literally look like cookie galleries! 

We chat about her life as a business owner, but also as a friend, wife, dog mom and the person behind the brand.

If you’ve ever wondered how to create a brand people become obsessed with, while remaining true to who you are in the process, this episode is for you. Plus if you want to see some BTS of how those delicious cookies are made, TUNE IN!

caption:
@natdoumkos has been a loyal follower and lover of AC for quite some time so when I dmed her about collaborating on a custom cookie, it couldn’t have been a better fit for both of us 🤍🤍 from initial concepting, to taste testing and content creation, it’s safe to say we have had a freaking BLAST. On behalf of both of us, we cannot wait for you guys to try this cookie!!🥣🍪✨ 

here’s the deets ✍🏻 (and there are lots because we really poured our heart and soul into the the making of this flavour!):

in the dough🍪: toasted milk powder for an incredible rich and nutty flavour profile complimented by white chocolate

on top 🥛: we really wanted this glaze to be the star of the show ⭐️ we soaked frosted flakes into whole milk to capture all it’s flavour and then used that flavoured milk to create a decadent creamy milky glaze full of sweet nostalgia 

the garnish🥣: ok hear me out, this may be the best snack to ever exist… we baked corn flakes in white sugar, butter, and toasted milk powder for a housemade caramelized corn flake crunch

absolutely zero details spared and we wouldn’t have it any other way. we hope this cookie takes you back to your parents couch on a Saturday morning, cereal bowl in hand, cartons on repeat, life is good 🥰

caption:
behind the bake! 👩🏼‍🍳👩🏼‍💻 just a few days before Christmas so we rockinnnn in one our busiest seasons of the year 💃🏼

✨christmas bark (crack) recipe:
- preheat oven to 375
- line a pan sheet with parchment and 1 sleeve of saltine cracker (i heard ritz is also bomb😌 need to try that next)
- melt 2 sticks (270g) of butter with 1 cup (220g) of dark or light brown sugar (I’ve done both, both delicious)
- boil sugar and butter for 3 mins and then quickly pour over crackers (they may float around - all good) try to spread as best you can
- bake for 5 mins
- remove from oven and sprinkle 2 cups (350g) of chocolate chips on top once the bubbling subsides
- allow a few mins to melt and then spread with a spatula
- I topped mine with sprinkles, pecans and flaky sea salt but you can do whatever you’d like!🙂
- pop this in the freezer for 15 mins before breaking apart. store in the fridge!! I think it’s best enjoyed when cold🥰

caption:
HOW TO FREEZE YOUR COOKIES 🥶🍪📝

this video is a bit long so here’s the coles notes😂👇🏻💁🏼‍♀️
- transfer to an airtight container or sealed bag
- allow to thaw at room temp for 1.5-2 hours *I did 1.5 because I keep my home fairly warm😅
- I don’t recommend ovens or microwaves especially for cookies with glazes 
- airfryer is so legit for anything without glazes as well (although I have done knafeh in there and it was 💣) - 350 degrees for 3-4 mins
- IFFF you do want to use the oven or microwave to get them warm, start with very little time and work your way up - you can always add more time but cannot take away 😊
- can be frozen for up to 3 months
- this is hands down the best way to preserve your cookies, stash your faves, and always make sure you have a little something sweet for when that craving hits 😏💥
